required_actions.action: Open the printer troubleshooter in the Get Help app (Windows 11)
Power off the printer, unplug it, wait about 30 seconds, plug it back in, and power it on
Confirm the USB cable is firmly connected from the printer to the PC
If the status reads 'Printer in error state', check for low paper or ink, an open cover, or a paper jam
Wireless network check (not needed: the user connects by USB cable)

The page also says 'Make sure your printer is turned on and connected' before Add device or Refresh, and 'If you don't see your device listed, select Add manually.' required_actions.action: Open Start, Settings, Bluetooth & Devices, Printers & scanners
Select the printer, select Remove, then select Yes
Make sure the printer is turned on and connected before adding it
Select Add device or Refresh
If the printer does not appear, select Add manually
If the printer still fails, install the latest driver from the manufacturer or the linked driver guide
